text.template: Drunk, hard/wet, refused — and something dark in you ({{cor}} corruption) whispers to take what was denied. An adult who said NO is walking home alone. This is the line.

effects.tpl: You do it — brutal, fast, unforgivable — and the world answers at once: {{yrs}} year(s), record #{{s.crime}}, job gone, prestige gutted, scandal everywhere, leverage rotting in drawers. {{c.name}} will never look at you the same. There is no undoing.
You fist the wall till it bleeds and walk home shaking. Discipline +8. The hunger stays caged. Barely.
